svg.aria-label: OpenArm real and sim data collection, training and evaluation pipeline
svg.text: OpenArm Pringles hand-over: real + sim data collection → training → evaluation
Every dataset is written by the official lerobot-record / LeRobotDataset in one format, so any mix can be trained, and every policy runs on the real arm or in Isaac Sim.
UDP :5006 · X start / save · Y discard · triggers grip
pose mapping · 1€ filter · mink IK ≈500 Hz → joints
X → drive → X → slow return home (recorded) → save
home approach · step limit · safety hold · grip squeeze
the same IK and safety logic as on the real arm
openarm_umeow code; only the _hw_* layer swapped
TCP :5710 · lockstep 1/30 s · new scene each episode
16-D joint targets + scene states · saved episodes only
lighting · materials · camera pose · pad height · can size
recorded IK joint command → action · calibration units
One dataset format for all three → mergeable with lerobot-edit-dataset
keys RJ1, LJ1 … RJ8, LJ8 · motor radians · grippers in raw motor angle · state = measured joints · action = joint command · 30 fps · robot_type openarm_umeow · 3 cameras 640×480
SmolVLA (cameras renamed camera1/2/3) · GR00T N1.7 (relative actions)
CAN + RealSense · same cameras and task prompt as training
automatic scene reset · success tally per episode · optional randomization
Same four inference modes for both: normal (lerobot-rollout) · RTC (--inference.type=rtc) · async (policy_server + robot_client) · async + RTC
each episode: the policy drives for episode_time_s → slow return home (≤ 0.3 rad/s), checked → reset the scene (automatic in sim) → next episode
